title: Goldenplus at Taiwan Smart Agriweek 2026
summary: A look back at our embedded HMI and display technology showcase at Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center, September 8–10, 2026.
imageAlt: Goldenplus Electronics embedded HMI booth at Taiwan Smart Agriweek 2026

event.name: Taiwan Smart Agriweek 2026
event.location: Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center, Hall 1, Taiwan

content.text: Goldenplus Electronics showcased embedded human-machine interface (HMI) technology at Taiwan Smart Agriweek 2026. Our exhibition displays included the Omni HMI and Omni PLC families, Aeternus HMI products, and Brilliant Display Editor (BDE), our visual GUI development environment.

The booth highlighted how graphical interfaces and embedded control hardware can be combined for equipment monitoring and automation applications. Visitors could explore a range of display sizes, control interfaces, and demonstrations on site.

items: Omni Display: HMI and PLC-oriented interface systems presented with integrated control features.
Aeternus Display: embedded displays for user-interface and peripheral integration applications.
Brilliant Display Editor: graphical interface design and software development workflow.
Application demonstrations: interactive control panels and prototype equipment displayed at the booth.

content.text: Selected photos from the Goldenplus exhibition booth, including hardware exhibits, the BDE display, and demonstration setups.
For more information, explore our Display Hardware and BDE Software pages.
